iso_image.description: Path to the ISO image file to inspect; must be provided.

dumpdisks.description: If true, dump each El Torito boot image into separate files (image.1, image.2, ...).

dumphex.description: If true, dump El Torito structure in hexadecimal (ignored if --xml is set).

xml.description: If true, dump El Torito structure as XML to standard output.
